steps.title: Angles and triangles
steps.content: A straight angle is 180° and a full turn is 360°. The interior angles of a triangle sum to 180°. A right angle is 90°.
steps.example: If a triangle has angles 50° and 60°, the third is 180−50−60 = 70°.

steps.title: Find a missing angle
steps.prompt: A triangle has angles 45° and 65°. What is the third angle?

steps.title: Area and perimeter
steps.content: Perimeter measures the distance around a shape. Area measures the surface inside. For a rectangle, perimeter = 2(l+w) and area = l×w.
steps.example: A rectangle of length 8 and width 3 has perimeter 22 and area 24 square units.

steps.title: Use Pythagoras
steps.prompt: A right triangle has perpendicular sides 3 and 4. What is its hypotenuse?

steps.title: Choose the correct formula
steps.content: For a circle, circumference = 2πr and area = πr². Check whether a question asks for length around the shape or the area inside it.
steps.tip: Keep units: perimeter is in length units; area is in square units.

questions.prompt: What is the sum of interior angles of a triangle?
questions.explanation: The interior angles of every triangle sum to 180°.
